payload.description: Norwich publishes 22 of its 39 registers of interests as scanned pictures of a paper form, with no text in the file. A scan can be looked at but not read by a computer, searched, or quoted, so nothing from those 22 is shown here. Each councillor's page links their own form so you can read it yourself.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
